text:
Evelyn: Quick copy + a11y check please  We have a 'Restore conflict' modal when someone else edited a session concurrently. Need wording that explains options and which version will be kept.
Tom: Paste current copy?
Evelyn: Current header: 'Restore conflict' body: 'Your changes conflict with a newer version. Choose which to keep.' Buttons: 'Keep mine' / 'Use theirs'
Rashid: 'Use theirs' reads harsh & unclear. Also 'Keep mine' is ambiguous for non-native speakers.
A11yTeam: For SR users, avoid possessives alone. Prefer explicit labels like 'Keep my edits' and 'Use latest version'. Also ensure modal role=dialog, aria-labelledby points to header, and aria-describedby to body.
Tom: We also need to communicate merge option if available. Do we offer merging?
Evelyn: We do a simple merge for text fields only and show a preview if merge succeeds; otherwise we show choices. Copy should reflect that.
Rashid: Suggest header: 'Conflict detected' Body lines: 1) 'Someone saved changes to this session after you started editing.' 2) 'We can try to merge your edits with the latest version. If merging fails, pick which version to keep.'
A11yTeam: Good. For SR-friendly flow, add a short aria-live polite message on modal open: 'Conflict detected. Merge recommended.' So screen readers hear the suggested action early. Also add aria-describedby on the confirm buttons pointing to the explanation about merge outcomes.
Evelyn: Buttons: primary: 'Try merge' secondary: 'Keep my edits' tertiary: 'Use latest version' (tertiary as link-style) Thoughts?
Tom: 'Try merge' implies effort; maybe say 'Merge changes' to be actionable.
Rashid: Order matters. Primary = safest path. If merge usually succeeds, primary as 'Merge changes' is fine. But if merge often fails, maybe primary should be 'Review differences'. We have preview step after attempt; merge can be previewed.
A11yTeam: Also support keyboard: focus should land on the primary action. If merge might disrupt, ensure there is a clear warning in the preview with role=status on result. For labels, avoid ambiguous 'changes' alone. 'Merge changes' is ok.
Evelyn: Final suggested copy: header: 'Conflict detected' body: 'Someone saved changes to this session after you started editing. We can attempt to merge your edits with the latest version. If merging fails, you can choose which version to keep.' Primary: 'Merge changes' Secondary: 'Keep my edits' Link: 'Use latest version' SR-live on open: 'Conflict detected. Merge changes recommended.' aria-describedby id on primary -> body id.
Tom: Microcopy nit: 'latest version' vs 'their version'  prefer 'latest version' for clarity.
Rashid: Also add small helper text under buttons when merge succeeds/fails: success: 'Merged successfully 13 show diff' fail: 'Merge failed. Choose which version to keep.' Those messages should use role=status so SRs are notified.
DesignBot: Checklist: explicit labels (Keep my edits, Use latest version), declarative header, explain merge behavior, aria-live polite on open, aria-describedby on primary action, role=status for merge results, focus primary by default, preview step for diffs.
A11yTeam: Acceptance criteria: screen reader reads 'Conflict detected. Merge changes recommended.' on modal open, merge result announcements via role=status, buttons have aria-describedby linking to body, keyboard focus order tested NVDA/VoiceOver.
Evelyn: Great  I'll update figma with the new copy and add the a11y implementation notes to the ticket. Thanks! :thumbsup:
